DOV_2008_p69__paragraph_0.ocr:
Total intangible amortization expense for the twelve months ended December 31, 2008, 2007 and 2006 was
$101.9 million, $92.1 million and $67.0 million, respectively. Amortization expense, based on current intangible
balances is estimated to be $96.1 million in 2009, $95.6 million in 2010, $92.3 million in 2011, $76.1 million in
2012 and $74.3 million in 2013.

DOV_2008_p69__paragraph_1.ocr:
During 2008 the Company closed on a sale of a line of business in the Electronic Technologies segment
resulting in a $7.5 million ($7.5 million after-tax) gain, which was recorded in Selling and administrative expenses
in the Consolidated Statement of Operations.

DOV_2008_p69__paragraph_2.ocr:
In addition, during 2008, the Company discontinued one business and completed the sale of one previously
discontinued business. At December 31, 2008, only one business remains held for sale. The major classes of
discontinued assets and liabilities included in the Consolidated Balance Sheets are as follows:
